_meta.description: Golden accept/reject decisions of ReSchema's function gate (validate_function, plus flagged submit_function spec rejects) and program gate (engine.program_gate), extracted from existing test assertions only.

conventions.function.expect.stage: divergence['stage'] on reject; null = behavioural divergence (no stage key) or accept. expect.field (ret|mem|crash) given when the test pins it. expect.stage_pinned=false = only ok==false is asserted; stage then holds the best inference, not a pinned value.
conventions.function.call_path: submit_function / regrade pass size=<manifest fn size> to validate_function (scout scrape window); validate_function means a direct call with size=None (0x400 window). addr is the manifest address of func unless addr_override is set.
conventions.function.gate_level: validate_function = decided by validate_function; submit_function = rejected by Param.from_json inside submit_function before validate_function runs (response reason 'spec', no divergence).
conventions.function.seed: the effective fuzz seed; seed_pinned=false would mean fresh entropy (none here).
conventions.program.cases: recorded cases in replay order (store.recorded() sorts by trace label); argv excludes argv[0]; stdin as hex.
conventions.program.hidden_seed: null = test does not pin it (fresh entropy). hidden_reached = whether the gate gets past the recorded stage.
conventions.program.scope: program_gate = full gate outcome; recorded_only = only compile_model + replay_against on the recorded cases is pinned (accepted=true means passes the recorded stage).
conventions.program.expect.reason_pinned: false = reason not asserted by any test.
